low_same_part_other_truck.author: MustangDriver
low_same_part_other_truck.title: For Race Use
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Filters out everything as long as it's larger than a small rock. Everything else is going straight into the engine. Ran this filter straight out of the box for roughly 10,000 miles and when I opened the airbox and looked down the intake tube I saw nothing but fine dirt heading straight to the throttle body. If you like compression loss and oil consumption issues - This is the filter for you. If you're running this for track use only - it's fine. If it's your daily - run O.E.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: K&N Drop-In Replacement Air Filter (10-14 Mustang GT; 12-13 Mustang BOSS 302; 11-14 Mustang V6)
